patterns.note: Asymmetrical, high-contrast layouts with large, bold typography dominating sections and ample negative space.
Extreme contrast between monumental, condensed display headings and elegant, smaller serif body text, often paired with tiny uppercase sans-serif labels.
A stark monochromatic palette of black and white, with dark grey used sparingly for secondary text, emphasizing high contrast.

A monumental, oversized brand name graphic is integrated into the page flow, scrolling with the content but so large that it acts as a continuous visual anchor, slowly revealing its full form across multiple screen heights.
Sections are clearly delineated by thin horizontal rules, often introduced by a small, uppercase label followed by a large, bold heading.

technique_notes: A sticky header maintains navigation access while the main content scrolls beneath it.

A full-page-height, oversized brand graphic is placed as a background element within the document flow, allowing foreground content to scroll over it. Its immense scale ensures it remains a dominant visual presence throughout the scroll, creating a sense of continuous brand immersion.
Content sections are revealed with a simple appearance as they enter the viewport, maintaining a clean and focused presentation without complex animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed display headings (~8-10x body) with elegant, smaller serif body text and tiny, uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and elements, creating a sense of grandeur and allowing typography to breathe.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of oversized, condensed typography, particularly the 'PURPORT' graphic, which acts as a persistent, almost architectural brand element throughout the scroll. This, combined with the stark black-and-white palette and minimalist layout, creates a powerful, editorial, and almost art-gallery-like experience.
